description: This file defines the DriverService class, responsible for managing driver-related operations such as retrieving all drivers and fetching a driver by ID within the NeuroFleetX backend system.

classes.name: DriverService
classes.description: A Spring service component that provides methods to retrieve driver information from the UserRepository.

methods.name: getAllDrivers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users with the DRIVER role.

methods.name: getDriverById
methods.description: Fetches a user by their unique ID, returning null if not found.
